name: RugRadar
tagline: Read-only rug and scam checks for Solana tokens, wallets and links
description: A remote MCP server that checks any Solana token (mint address, pump.fun or DexScreener link, or $TICKER) for rug-pull and scam risk: a 0-100 score with red flags such as mint/freeze authority, holder concentration, dev launch history, linked insider wallets, LP lock and a honeypot sell test, plus a link to the full report. It also scans public wallets and checks links for wallet-drainer patterns. It never needs a wallet connection, signature, private key or seed phrase. The free tier needs no key.
